name: Water's Bounty
storyline:
An intense, open-world tale of high-seas trading, naval warfare, and tactical survival.

Set across a vast global map, Water's Bounty thrusts you into a sea full of nonstop dangers. You'll navigate a world dominated by the ruthless Ronek Trading Company; a commercial empire branding all independent merchants as pirates to protect their monopoly. Risk other dangerous factions as well, from the Faithful, a radical religious group spreading fanatical zeal across the world, to a tyrant King who unleashes his royal fleet on anyone entering his waters, every faction poses a deadly threat.

Choose your protagonist, build a loyal crew, and fight to survive and claim the ocean's riches. Can you avenge your parents deaths?
